description: Create one invoice per currency for a client's sessions (by id or by calendar month) and email it. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant. The invoice only sends a request the client pays on Appty.

booking_ids.description: Sessions to put on the invoice. Pass this or period.

confirm.description: Set true only after the caller has seen a preview and wants it done. Anything else, including the string "true", is a preview and changes nothing.

period.description: Calendar month YYYY-MM in the provider's time zone. Uninvoiced sessions in that month.

name: send_invoice
title: Send an invoice
